key.name: tuple-path
key.description: Leave empty to look on PATH, then $XDG_BIN_HOME and ~/.local/bin. When set, only this path is used.

key.name: show-call-timer
key.summary: Show the call duration in the top bar

key.name: notify-favorites-online
key.summary: Notify when a favorite comes online

key.name: notify-call-cards
key.summary: Show notification cards posted into the call
key.description: Mirrors the notices and questions that agents and integrations post into the current call (tuple notifications) as desktop notifications.

key.name: shortcut-answer
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut: answer a ringing call

key.name: shortcut-leave
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut: leave or cancel the call

key.name: shortcut-join-clipboard
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut: join the Tuple link on the clipboard

key.name: update-command
key.summary: Command that installs the latest Tuple release
key.description: Leave empty to use the update-tuple script bundled with the extension.

key.name: debug-log
key.description: Appends how Tuple reports each call state change to ~/.cache/tuple-deck/state-log.ndjson.
